items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Joe Oliver, Johnny Dodge, see? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: That's why they cut all that stuff out when the guys playing them bands.

Yeah, yeah, yeah. And them kind of fellas, like Will Hines and them and them guys from Chicago, New York, they think, you know, New Orleans musicians ain't nothing they can't read. Yeah. And Louis played his way and showed them that he could read. Oh yeah. All that gang, you know. Joe Oliver, Johnny Dodge, see? Yeah. Punch now, there wasn't no classification like that. No, that's what I'm saying. And he come up there and try to, Guy Kelly went up there and played with him. Oh, Guy was telling him. Guy could cheat…
